# Copilot instructions

This repo has two parts. Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) first, then the `AGENTS.md` of the part you are working in:

- [`fish-audio/AGENTS.md`](../fish-audio/AGENTS.md): the Fish Audio voice examples (TTS, STT, agents). Voice is the focus of the hackathon.
- [`game-kit/AGENTS.md`](../game-kit/AGENTS.md): the 3D browser game kit (engine, samples, assets, `npm run check`, `npm run smoke`).
